title: The 7th International Verification of Neural Networks Competition (VNN-COMP 2026): Summary and Results
abstract: arXiv:2611.24114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This report summarizes the seventh International Verification of Neural Networks Com- petition (VNN-COMP 2026), held as part of the Symposium on AI Verification (SAIV) co-located with the International Conference on Computer-Aided Verification (CAV) at FLoC 2026 in Lisbon, Portugal. The goal of the competition is to provide an objective comparison of the state-of-the-art methods in neural network verification, in terms of scal- ability and speed. Along this line, we used standard formats (ONNX for neural networks and VNNLIB for specifications), standard hardware (all tools are run by the organizers on AWS), and tool parameters provided by the tool authors. This report summarizes the rules, benchmarks, participating tools, results, and lessons learned from this competition.

translated_title: 第七届国际神经网络验证竞赛（VNN-COMP 2026）：总结与结果
translated_abstract: 本报告总结了第七届国际神经网络验证竞赛（VNN-COMP 2026），该竞赛作为人工智能验证研讨会（SAIV）的一部分，与计算机辅助验证国际会议（CAV）共同在葡萄牙里斯本举办的FLoC 2026会议上举行。竞赛的目标是对最先进的神经网络验证方法在可扩展性和速度方面进行客观比较。为此，竞赛采用了标准格式（神经网络使用ONNX，规约使用VNNLIB）、标准硬件环境（所有工具均由组织者在AWS上运行）以及由工具作者提供的工具参数。本报告总结了本次竞赛的规则、基准测试、参赛工具、比赛结果以及经验教训。
tldr: 第七届国际神经网络验证竞赛（VNN-COMP 2026）通过统一的标准格式、标准化硬件环境和作者指定的工具参数，对最先进的神经网络验证工具在可扩展性和速度方面进行了客观比较，并总结了竞赛规则、基准测试、结果与经验教训。
en_tdlr: The 7th International Verification of Neural Networks Competition (VNN-COMP 2026) objectively compared state-of-the-art neural network verification tools in scalability and speed using standard formats, uniform hardware, and author-provided parameters, summarizing rules, benchmarks, results, and lessons learned.
